name: toast
title: Toast
description: shadcn's older Radix toast in the brand's toast look: a white bordered panel at the bottom center with a title, a muted line, an outline action and a close.
usage: Confirm a background action finished or failed (Key revoked, Batch started) with an optional undo. Call toast() from anywhere and mount one Toaster. For new work prefer the Sonner toaster (sonner), which this matches.
avoid: Errors people must act on (show them in place)
Toasts that stay until dismissed for routine confirmations

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
